supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic HTTPS activity is visible: WS-BCARTER-01 made proxy CONNECT requests to update.chartmate-imaging.net from 13:38 through 14:08 UTC at roughly five-minute intervals; several were successful, while some returned 407 or 502.

The connections are tied to C:\Users\ben.carter\AppData\Local\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe, running as ben.carter; the supplied inventory instead identifies the approved ChartMate updater at C:\Program Files\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe and its expected update host as update.chartmate-imaging.com. This mismatch is suspicious and is not explained by the listed approved updater.
Sysmon recorded a file-create event for the AppData cmupdate.exe during the same activity, adding concern that this is not simply the inventoried Program Files updater.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels and metadata, not the encrypted session contents; the supplied records do not establish what data, if any, was exchanged inside the tunnels.
The provided records do not include a hash, signature, or other identity validation for the AppData cmupdate.exe.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the contents or ultimate purpose of the HTTPS traffic.
The evidence does not establish whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is an authorized ChartMate endpoint or whether the AppData binary is signed or otherwise legitimate.
The evidence does not establish data theft or other specific impact.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and preserve the AppData cmupdate.exe; calculate its hash and verify its digital signature, provenance, and reputation.
Validate update.chartmate-imaging.net against ChartMate through an independent trusted channel, and review DNS, certificate, and proxy/TLS inspection details for the alert window.
Investigate the host for persistence, related files or processes, and any follow-on activity associated with the executable.
unrelated_findings: ZoomUpdate.exe ran on WS-BCARTER-01; Zoom is not listed among the approved software in the supplied inventory. Review separately rather than treating it as evidence for this alert. (T015-00062, T015-00063, T015-00142, T015-00143)
ZSAService.exe from the Zscaler path started on WS-BCARTER-01; it is not listed among the approved software in the supplied inventory. Validate separately. (T015-00120, T015-00121)
WS-BCARTER-01 connected to FILE-HD-01 over SMB and FILE-HD-01 recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon; review separately. (T015-00253, T015-00255, T015-00256, T015-00257)
